3171.title: Tasks search treats multiple words as one phrase
3171.rootCauseOneLine: The Tasks store puts the entire trimmed query into one SQL LIKE parameter, making spaces and term order literal phrase requirements.
3171.proposedFix: Build one escaped title, description, or task-key predicate per whitespace-delimited term and combine the term groups with AND.
3171.caveats: The external board's exact row counts were not verified; the store-level behavior was reproduced twice on trusted main.
